EditorTextSize.reason: Windows editor preferences use absolute WPF font points (EditorPreferencesViewModel.FontSize); Mac uses percentage scale. Keep the existing points announcement in the explicit preference residue register.

HeadingScrollFailed.reason: Mac updateNSView can fail an AppKit scroll request after locating a heading. Windows uses core offsets and the editor navigation request, with HeadingNotFound at failed resolution; it has no AppKit scroll-failure stage.

SaveConflict.reason: Owner approved D-10 (2026-09-19): Windows retains the unsaved buffer and inline status and posts from the save boundary; a write conflict posts NoteSaveConflict (D-10 as amended by W7-7, #1249), mac's sentence without its dialog clause. Mac SaveConflict refers to its overwrite/reload dialog, which Windows does not have.

ShowingNote.reason: Windows tab/pane activation posts TabFocused/EditorPaneFocused with the note title; Mac NoteContentView separately posts ShowingNote on appearance. Retain one Windows focus route.

WelcomeShown.reason: The Mac sentence promises Command-O and Open Vault focus. Windows uses native welcome controls and their focus/name semantics; do not post the platform-specific Mac sentence.

QuickSwitcherCount.reason: Mac constructs SwitcherRecentCount, SwitcherNoMatches and SwitcherMatchCount in QuickSwitcherModel.publishAnnouncement; Windows QuickSwitcherCount renders the same three state templates.

ReadingNavLanded.reason: G21/G23: Windows app-owned reading navigation chords provide guaranteed structural movement/landing speech. Mac uses native VoiceOver reading navigation; these Windows command triggers do not exist on Mac.

ReadingNavNoTarget.reason: G21/G23: Windows app-owned reading navigation chords provide guaranteed structural movement/landing speech. Mac uses native VoiceOver reading navigation; these Windows command triggers do not exist on Mac.

NoteSaveBlocked.reason: D-10 owner-approved Windows inline save-failure notification. Mac retains SaveConflict with its dialog and the existing save-error UI; no change to Mac recovery behavior is claimed.

FileReopenFailed.reason: D-11 owner-approved Windows failed-load notification while retaining the recovery tab. Mac refuses missing paths with ReopenTargetMissing and retains its existing open-error handling.

BasesDashboardLoadFailed.reason: D-12 owner-approved Windows announcement of the published failed dashboard section. Mac DashboardDocument.load retains its failed state and the pre-dock BasesDashboardMissing check.

ShellRegionFocused.reason: W7-6 (#1240): Mac has no F6 / Shift+F6 shell-region cycling and navigates panes directionally only; ShellRegionFocused is a recorded Windows-only affordance with no Mac construction site.

NoteSaveConflict.reason: D-10 as amended (W7-7, #1249): Windows has no resolve dialog, so a write conflict speaks mac's conflict sentence without the dialog clause. Mac keeps posting SaveConflict with its Keep mine / Reload dialog; no change to Mac recovery behavior is claimed. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`ConflictingSaveSpeaksTheConflictSentence`); no journey observes its delivery until PR 1's desktop listener (#1244).

CitationPopoverShown.reason: W7-7 (#1251): a screen reader does not read a pane's name when focus lands inside it, so the Windows citation popover announces its outcome on activation. Mac's CitationPopover carries the same summary as its accessibility label and moves VoiceOver focus to the title or unresolved notice on appear; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`ActivatingACitationAnnouncesCoresSentenceAndNamesThePopoverWithIt`, `HoveringACitationShowsThePopoverWithoutAnnouncing`); the announcement leg of `FluentShell_UiaPatternsKeyboardFocusAndAxe_AreClean` is pending PR 1's desktop listener (#1244), and until it lands that journey asserts the popover's name and focus, not the announcement.

EmbedPreviewShown.reason: W7-7 (#1251): the Windows embed preview opens on Close, where its name is not read, so it announces the landed result. Mac removed its own preview-opened announcement (audit #211) because VoiceOver reads the popover's accessibility label; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`AResolvedEmbedAnnouncesItsPreviewWhenTheResultLands`); the announcement leg of `FluentShell_UiaPatternsKeyboardFocusAndAxe_AreClean` is pending PR 1's desktop listener (#1244), and until it lands that journey asserts the preview's focus and its second-line read, not the announcement.

EmbedPreviewUnavailable.reason: W7-7 (#1251): the Windows embed preview opens on Close, where its name is not read, so it announces an unresolved result, handing core the resolver's semantic reason to word. Mac removed its own preview-opened announcement (audit #211) because VoiceOver reads the popover's accessibility label; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`AnUnresolvedEmbedIsWordedByCoreOnEverySurface`, `EveryUnavailableReasonIsOneCoreRenderingOnEverySurface`, `TheUnavailableSurfacesConsumeTheRenderedCoreEvent`); no journey opens an unavailable preview, and none observes its delivery until PR 1's desktop listener (#1244).

CitationSummaryShown.reason: W7-7 (#1251): the Windows summary sheet opens on its Walk/Done button, where its name is not read, so it announces its counts. Mac's CitationSummarySheet carries the summary in its accessibility label so VoiceOver reads it on appear; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`OpeningTheSummaryAnnouncesItsCounts`); the announcement leg of `CitationSurfaces_GridsSheetsAndChords_AreClean` is pending PR 1's desktop listener (#1244), and until it lands that journey asserts the sheet's appearance and axe scan, not the announcement.

CitationDetailsShown.reason: W7-7 (#1251): the Windows citation details sheet opens on Close, where its name is not read, so it announces what it expanded. Mac's CitationPopover carries that summary as its accessibility label and moves VoiceOver focus to the title on appear; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`OpeningCitationDetailsAnnouncesTheExpandedCitation`); the announcement leg of `CitationSurfaces_GridsSheetsAndChords_AreClean` is pending PR 1's desktop listener (#1244), and until it lands that journey asserts the sheet's placement and focus, not the announcement.

CitationDetailsUnresolved.reason: W7-7 (#1251): the Windows citation details sheet opens on Close, where its name is not read, so a key no bibliography holds announces as unresolved, in mac CitationPopover's own label sentence moved into core. Mac carries that sentence as the popover's accessibility label and moves VoiceOver focus to the unresolved notice on appear; Mac constructs no such event in this wave and its owner decides. Current Windows evidence is hosted (`OpeningCitationDetailsAnnouncesTheExpandedCitation`); no journey opens an unresolved key's details, and none observes its delivery until PR 1's desktop listener (#1244).

SidebarFilterCleared.reason: W7-7 R-3 (#1250, codex PR 2 round 1): Windows keeps one always-visible sidebar status line, so a clear - Clear Sidebar Filter or the field emptied by the user - replaces the cleared filter's summary with this sentence and speaks it once. Mac's filter overlay, with its summary, disappears on Escape, which stays silent; no Mac construction site.
